summary: Implemented fail-open manual test generation in src/goal/manual-tests.ts so LLM/auth/client failures now return step-derived fallback tests (while preserving [] when no done steps). Added/updated tests in src/goal/manual-tests.test.ts for auth-error and missing-ANTHROPIC_API_KEY fallback behavior, added agent-level regression in src/goal/agent-executor.test.ts verifying all_done emits fallback manualTests without manualTestsError on auth failure, and added Telegram button regression in src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts ensuring gTD renders actual details when fallback manualTests are present. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm build, and pnpm vitest run src/goal/manual-tests.test.ts src/goal/agent-executor.test.ts src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts.
